A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same UniVG research. All 11 pages, including equations, tables, figures, and references, support comparison. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original UniVG benchmark results, training ablations, model-scaling results, and inference measurements in Section 4, Tables 2–7, and Figure 5.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains the original UniVG evaluations, ablations, model-scaling results, and inference measurements in Section 4.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same MM-DiT architecture, channel concatenation, external conditioning, flow-matching objective, inference procedure, and three-stage training recipe.

E1.justification: Training data and task coverage are unchanged. Both MagicBrush and EmuEdit already appear in the editing evaluations in both versions; correcting Figure 5's benchmark label does not establish additional coverage.

E2.justification: Tables 2–4 and 7 retain identical comparator memberships, including OneDiff, OmniGen, and the corresponding task-specific baselines.

E3.justification: Training budgets, data mixtures, evaluation metrics, B/L/XL model configurations, and inference measurement settings remain unchanged. Figure 5's label correction does not document a revised experimental procedure.

E4.justification: The training-stage and multi-task ablations, scaling analysis, efficiency study, and qualitative examples are retained. Figure 5 corrects benchmark attribution without changing the scaling design, plotted values, or trend.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The point-estimate reporting practice is unchanged.

E6.justification: Figure 5 reattributes the B/L/XL CLIP-T scores 22.2, 24.4, and 25.9 from MagicBrush to EmuEdit. This changes the benchmark-specific meaning of those results, without changing their values or establishing a performance gain. All other reported results are unchanged.

T1.justification: The mathematical formulation in Section 3, including Equations 1–3 and classifier-free guidance, is unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about unified generation and editing, preserving text-to-image performance, training insights, and comparisons with unified baselines.

C2.justification: Interpretations of task synergy, ID-related forgetting, architectural efficiency, and model scaling remain identical. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: Encoder and VAE specifications, hyperparameters, training hardware, inference settings, data-processing descriptions, and the AXLearn access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, positioning relative to OmniGen and OneDiffusion, and all 73 references are unchanged.

P1.justification: The Figure 5 caption changes 'MagicBrush' to 'EmuEdit,' and the first-page arXiv version/date stamp is updated. Other prose and document structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 5 changes the editing subplot's benchmark label and corresponding caption from MagicBrush to EmuEdit. Its bars and arrangement, all other figures and tables, and the overall layout are retained.

improvement.justification: The corrected Figure 5 attribution makes its XL CLIP-T score of 25.9 consistent with EmuEdit in Tables 3 and 6, which report 29.5 for MagicBrush. This resolves a misleading internal inconsistency and modestly improves reporting accuracy; the underlying scientific evidence otherwise remains unchanged.
